description: DB integration: migration schema sanity — create group calendar + shares; duplicate share upsert updates level; personal-calendar uniqueness and type check constraints reject invalid rows; schedule_entries.calendar_id FK rejects unknown calendar.
DB integration: resolver — direct read share, team free_busy share (max-level merge), inactive grantor ignored, user_schedule:update → edit on all, no share → invisible.

DB integration: getScheduleEntries for a viewer with mixed shares returns own full, shared-read full, shared private masked Busy (no title/notes/work item), free_busy masked, group calendar entries, excludes unshared users and archived calendars; recurring series masked per instance.
DB integration: getScheduleEntryById returns not-found for no access, masked for busy, and requires user_schedule:read.

DB integration: delegate edit — edit share can create entry for owner and move owner's entry; read share rejected on create/update/delete; private entry of owner rejected; assigning a non-editable user rejected.

DB integration: group calendar — edit member creates entry (is_private forced false), read member rejected, manage member updates shares, last-manager removal rejected, non-manager rename rejected, admin can manage orphaned calendar.
DB integration: revocation — removing a share, removing user from team, and deleting the team each revoke visibility on next fetch.
Share actions guard: self-share rejected, client-portal grantee rejected, manage level on personal calendar rejected, non-owner non-admin cannot change another user's shares; admin can.
Notification: granting a share to a user publishes CALENDAR_SHARE_GRANTED and creates an internal notification for the grantee; team grant does not.
API: GET /api/v1/schedules as non-admin with a read share includes the sharer's entries (masked private) and excludes unshared users.

Component: schedule sidebar renders People/Group calendars from getCalendarsVisibleToMe, toggling persists preference and restores on remount, stale calendars dropped; capabilities replace read:all check.
Component: EntryPopup — selecting a group calendar hides Private toggle and allows no assignees; busy entry opens read-only Busy popup; assignee options limited to editable users.
Component: Share my calendar dialog adds a user and a team with levels, changes a level, removes a share, and calls setMyCalendarShares with the expected payload.
Component: group calendar dialog creates calendar with name/color/members and archive action is visible only to managers.

E2E (Playwright): User A shares calendar with B (View details); B toggles A on and sees A's entry and a private entry as Busy; A creates group calendar with B as Edit; B creates an entry on it that A sees.
i18n: new msp/schedule keys exist in all supported locales (locale key parity check).

Regression: a Technician with only user_schedule:read (no user:read) gets active internal users from getShareableUsers (excludes inactive and client users), the share picker lists them with no 'Not assigned' option, and getShareableTeams returns lead names.
